mentions.name: vibedb
mentions.description: A minimalist, text-based memory system for naturally storing and recalling important events. It emphasizes simplicity, portability, and human-friendly structure using six optional fields (who, what, when, where, how, and thing) that capture factual context, deferring interpretation for later use or analysis.
